content: Official Godot stable GD0001, C# exports, Node and thread-safe API documentation confirms partial GodotObject classes, Variant-compatible exports, child-before-parent Ready order and unsafe active SceneTree access across threads. Use engine lifecycle adapters with explicit dependency binding and pure C# domain state; validate generated code and nullable exports with build and scene-instantiation proofs. Context7 and ctx7 unavailable; searched and cross-checked direct official documentation on 2026-11-13.
